title: Sexually Transmitted Diseases (STDs) by State
description: Number and incidence of sexually transmitted diseases (STDs) by state, covering HIV, AIDS, chancroid, gonorrhea, and syphilis.

fields.name: date
fields.title: Date
fields.description: [Date] The date in YYYY-MM-DD format, with MM-DD set to 01-01 as the data is at annual frequency

fields.name: state
fields.title: State
fields.description: [Categorical] One of 16 states, or Malaysia; data for W.P. Putrajaya is subsumed under W.P. Kuala Lumpur.

fields.name: disease
fields.title: Disease
fields.description: [Categorical] The type of sexually transmitted disease (STD)

fields.name: cases
fields.title: Cases
fields.description: [Integer] Number of reported cases, classified based on the date of report

fields.name: incidence
fields.title: Incidence
fields.description: [Numeric] Incidence rate per 100,000 population in the state

methodology: This dataset is tabulated from administrative records on the notifications of infectious diseases collected by the Ministry of Health. The incidence is calculated as the number of new cases per 100,000 population, based on the [most recent population estimates](https://open.dosm.gov.my/data-catalogue/population_state).
caveat: In general, the data presented here is based on the date of report rather than the date of the event. Furthermore, there may be underreporting of cases to varying degrees depending on the disease and state.
